name: table-parser
body: GFM table parser and cell-extension decoder (gfm-tables). It reads the `body.tables` option a template declares (template-registry), parses each body's GFM tables — header row, delimiter row and body rows with strict column counts, leading and trailing pipes optional and cells trimmed, per-column alignment from the delimiter row, `\|` as a literal pipe, inline-Markdown cell content, the table ending at a blank line or another block's start (table-syntax) — decodes each cell's extensions (`{br}` and the `{…}` attribute groups, including the boolean/enum short-hands and the `\{` escape, table-cell-attributes), validates the parsed table against the template's declared limits (table-limits) and declared cell attributes (type-checking a value and suggesting the closest declared attribute for an unknown one), and hands each parsed table to the render context under `.table`/`.tables` (table-layout-context). Its seams are the template body rule and manifest parsing in internal/template (BodyRule, parseManifestBody, CheckBody), the Markdown walk in internal/mdcheck (table detection and validation), and the renderer's body/text rendering in internal/render (renderBody, renderInline).
